facts.title: ci: drop the aggregator job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index e77e045..49c7fa7 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -34,34 +34,6 @@ jobs:
       project_ref: v1
       check_name: checks
 
-  all-checks-passed:
-    name: ci / all-passed
-    needs: [floor, ruff, shellcheck, release-check]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Require every dependency to have succeeded (a job skipped on a mechanical PR is satisfied)
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-          MECHANICAL: ${{ needs.floor.outputs.mechanical }}
-          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A skipped job is satisfied on a mechanical PR (the floor skipped
-          # it) and on any non-PR event (a push to the default branch, where
-          # any job skipped by its own `if:` is not a PR's failure); on a
-          # functional PR a skipped job is a failure.
-          bad="$(jq -r --arg mech "$MECHANICAL" --arg event "$EVENT" '
-            to_entries[]
-            | select(.value.result == "failure" or .value.result == "cancelled"
-                     or (.value.result == "skipped" and $mech != "true" and $event == "pull_request"))
-            | .key' <<<"$RESULTS")"
-          if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
-            echo "required job(s) not satisfied: $bad"
-            exit 1
-          fi
-          echo "all checks passed (event=${EVENT} mechanical=${MECHANICAL:-false})"
-
   ruff:
     name: ci / ruff
     needs: [floor]

safety.name: safety
checked: Weakened-guard probe. The only change is that `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at the head sha removes the `all-checks-passed` job (`ci / all-passed`) and its comment block. I fetched the live branch rules for `main` (`gh api repos/example/project/rules/branches/main`). Ruleset 23658235 requires `trusted-scan / trusted-scan`, `ci / checks`, `ci / ruff`, `ci / shellcheck` and `ci / release-check`. It does not require `ci / all-passed`. So the removed check was not gating merges, and its protection was already off. That is not a finding under the card. Its extra rule (a skipped job counts as a failure on a non-mechanical PR) was not enforced by the ruleset either. The required checks still hold: if the floor fails, the required `ci / checks` fails; `ruff` and `shellcheck` still depend on `floor` (lines 39–40, 52–53); `release-check` still always runs (lines 63–84). This probe would have caught a required check or aggregator removed while the ruleset still enforced it, which would let a red PR merge.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the gating logic that was removed with what the ruleset now requires. At `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (head, lines 37–84), `ruff` and `shellcheck` are skipped only when the floor sets `mechanical=true` (lines 40, 53), which is the same condition under which the old aggregator let a skip through. `release-check` always runs. If the floor fails, the dependent jobs are skipped, but `ci / checks` itself fails and still blocks the merge. This would have caught a gap the aggregator used to close, where a skipped job on a functional PR passes a required check. There is no such path.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Compared what the removed `ci / all-passed` job enforced against what the remaining required checks enforce (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` at head 26033f1). This would have caught a gap in the merge gate after the aggregator is gone. The aggregator failed in three cases: (a) a `failure` or `cancelled` dependency; (b) a `skipped` `ruff`/`shellcheck` on a non-mechanical PR; (c) floor failure, which leaves its dependents skipped. Case (a) is still covered because each job is now its own required check. Case (b) can only happen when `needs.floor.outputs.mechanical == 'true'` (ci.yml:40, :53). The aggregator also passed in that case (`$mech != "true"` guard), so nothing changes. Case (c) is covered because the floor's only job-level check-run on this head is `ci / checks` (check-runs list at 26033f1). A floor failure therefore surfaces as a failing required `ci / checks`, not as a skip.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Read the diff at head 26033f1 and the whole `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at the head sha. The change only deletes the `all-checks-passed` job (base lines 37–63), with no line added or changed. This would have caught any new API, package, helper, abstraction layer or error-handling path. The diff has none.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.
